theorems.name: Submission.mean_curvature_monotonicity
theorems.statement: (∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : RectifiableVarifold n ℓ), 0 < n → IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts V.weight ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂V.weight, Module.finrank ℝ (V.tangentSpace x) = n) ∧ AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ (V.tangentSpace x).starProjection) V.weight) → BoundedCurvatureMonotonicity ∧ LogarithmicMonotonicityError ∧ LpMonotonicity ∧ LpDensity
